name: llm-course
description: Course to get into Large Language Models (LLMs) with roadmaps and Colab notebooks.
one_liner: A free, structured curriculum of notes and hands-on exercises for learning how large language models work and how to build with them.
buyer: A coding bootcamp or corporate learning-and-development team that wants ready-made curriculum content instead of building an LLM training course from scratch.
business_use_cases: A coding bootcamp adapts the curriculum structure to launch a paid 'AI Engineer' certificate track.
A corporate L&D department points upskilling engineers at it instead of buying an expensive external LLM training course.
An independent educator records paid video walkthroughs of each notebook and sells it as a cohort-based course on top of the free material.

money_ideas.idea: Build a paid cohort course with live mentorship structured around this free curriculum.

steal_this: Pick the three modules most relevant to your target learner, record yourself walking through them this weekend, and sell access as a mini-course.
